messages.author: Hanna Mäkelä
messages.text: Hi Olli, BGP sessions on edge router RTR-117 keep flapping since the firmware update this morning. Neighbors go down and up every few minutes. Any idea?

messages.author: Olli Rautio
messages.text: Which firmware version did it get?

messages.author: Olli Rautio
messages.text: Ok. Don't roll back yet. Sometimes the new release resets the BGP hold timers to a lower default, which makes the sessions drop under load.

messages.author: Hanna Mäkelä
messages.text: So should I revert the firmware?

messages.author: Olli Rautio
messages.text: No. Usually the firmware is fine. Check the logs first and look for hold timer expired messages. If you see them, it's probably the timer default.

messages.author: Hanna Mäkelä
messages.text: Yes. Logs show hold timer expired on all three neighbors. BGP session flapping.

messages.author: Olli Rautio
messages.text: That's it. Set the hold timer back to 90 seconds on the neighbors, then clear the sessions once. Don't power cycle the router unless that fails.

messages.author: Olli Rautio
messages.text: Good. This happens on some of the older release trains sometimes after an upgrade.

messages.author: Olli Rautio
messages.text: Not that I know of. We have just learned it from experience.
